body_markdown:
This was a fun exercise for me, and I hope[everyone who participated](https://www.hagerty.com/media/hagerty-community/whats-your-favorite-automotive-rivalry/comment-page-2/#comments) feels the same. Because when it comes to automotive rivalries, we all have memories of opponents in specific corners of car culture. The conflict often makes these folks larger than life, even if they are fictional characters. So have a look at these automotive rivalries below, and sound off in the comments with your selections and personal thoughts!


## Motorsport


ISC Archives/CQ-Roll Call Group/Getty Images


**Jim F:** Pearson vs Petty, when I was a kid!


**AS29:** Bob Glidden vs everyone.


**hyperv6:** Smokey Yunick vs racing tech and other racers.


**winguy:**[The Snake and The Mongoose](https://www.snakeandmongoosemovie.com/about) .


**Timothy W:** Bill Elliot and Dale Earnhardt. They were two of the most dominant NASCAR drivers in the ’80s, and there is no one who could upset the normally unflappable Elliot like Earnhardt.


**Jack B:** The GT1 Corvette vs Aston Martin/Prodrive Ferrari feud in the American Le Mans Series and at Le Mans was great back in the early 2000s.


**ADZ:** Earnhardt vs everyone else for sure. NASCAR lost its glitter without a bad boy, and Earnhardt was the baddest; everyone wanted to take him out.


**Cozy:** Gordon Johncock versus Ralph Donaldson, circa 1950s, early ’60s Jackson (Mich) Motor Speedway.


**hyperv6:** How about Garlits vs the NHRA and everyone else. He was crankier.


**Richard B:** WAAAAYY back in the day, Bob Tullius ( BMC / BL) vs Bob Sharp (Datsun) for honors in CP.


**Don K:** Senna vs Prost for sure.


**T Baly:** Me as well; Senna vs Prost was a classic.


**MrMCar:** It’s got to be Senna/Prost. At the end of the day, Senna’s mind games surely got the better of The Professor. Intended outcome achieved.


**Edward S:** Greg Anderson and Erica Enders.


**John S:** John Force and Doug Kalitta (NHRA).


**buster51:** AMC, Ford and Chevy in the Trans-Am.


**Nick D:** Henry Ford II vs Enzo Ferrari through the mid-’60s at the 24 hours of LeMans because it spawned the GT40 and is a great story!


**Frank S:** AJ Foyt vs Mario Andretti.


**DUB6:** Me against that guy in the ’69 Chevelle that one summer night in about 1971.


## Corporate


Don MacDonald/Getty Images


**hyperv6:** Zora Duntov vs Harley Earl and Bill Mitchell.


**Sajeev Mehta:**[Carlos Goshn](https://www.hagerty.com/media/entertainment/wanted-the-escape-of-carlos-ghosn-paints-a-stark-picture-of-greed-and-escape/) vs a lot of Japan?


**hyperv6:** John DeLorean and Pontiac vs GM.


**Frank S:** Chevy vs Ford!


## The Silver Screen


Courtesy Columbia Pictures/Sony Pictures


**Alan:** Ricky Bobby and that French guy Jean Girard.


**John S:** Jerry Bruckheimer and Rob Cohen, Gone in 60 Seconds (NC version) and Fast and the Furious (2001).
